topic: SehatFlow: AI-assisted invoice import (less manual typing)
caption:
Every supplier delivery comes with an invoice. Someone has to type it in. 🧾

In SehatFlow, the pharmacy management platform we built in-house, we added AI-assisted invoice import to cut down that manual data entry.

Why it matters:

▸ Less typing line by line at the end of a long day
▸ Purchases land in the same workspace as inventory and sales
▸ Reports run on the same data, not a separate spreadsheet

That's how we use AI in products: on the boring, repetitive step, so people can focus on the work that needs them.

Run a pharmacy? Take a look at sehatflow.com 🔗

Share this with a pharmacy owner you know. 🔁
